Sqlite.CreateIndex: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_article_title ON article (title);

PostgreSql.EnsureTable: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS article (id bigint);
PostgreSql.RenameColumn:
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'article'
          AND column_name = 'title'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'article'
          AND column_name = 'headline'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE "article" RENAME COLUMN "title" TO "headline"';
    END IF;
END $$;
PostgreSql.DropColumn: ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS "article" DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS "legacy_title";
